pattern: に相違ない（にそういない）
keywords: Plain clause / N / な-adjective + に相違ない
This handwriting must be my grandfather’s.
Without everyone’s help, it surely would not have been completed.
There must be a serious problem at the site.
formation: Plain clause / N / な-adjective + に相違ない
restrictions: Often based on a reasoned inference rather than direct observation.
mistake: This form expresses conviction, not absolute proof.

segments.role: Express a confident formal conclusion. Plain clause / N / な-adjective + に相違ない
